name: Dangote Sugar
source: CRON 2026-10-07: group five-year financial summary, printed page 85 of _ngx_pdf/DANGSUGAR.pdf (PDF page 87), read from the GROUP column as at 31 December 2025, in NGN thousands. Net Profit for FY2023, FY2022 and FY2021 was blank; the printed group loss or profit for the year is (73,760,308), 54,742,135 and 22,052,291 thousand. Income Tax is derived for those years as profit before taxation less the printed profit for the year. The stored cells held 4,185,136 thousand, 2 thousand and 3,377,543 thousand, which reconcile to nothing in the group accounts; 4,185,136 and 3,377,543 are the COMPANY income tax of 2025 and 2024 from the statement of value added. Unit: naira (printed NGN thousand x 1,000). | CRON 2026-10-07 NGX Q2 2026 filing fill: CORRECTION 2026-10-07. The stored H1 2026 column held the period profit after tax (41,507,438) in the Gross Profit and Operating Profit (EBIT) rows and a cost of sales derived from it. Replaced with the printed Group column headed 30/6/2026 of the consolidated and separate statement of profit or loss, NGN thousands: Revenue 391,854,524 (unchanged, already correct); Cost of Sales 298,000,126; Gross Profit 93,854,398; Operating profit 91,997,255; Finance costs net 47,468,714; Profit before tax 44,090,298; Taxation 2,582,860; Profit after tax 41,507,438; Basic earnings per share 3.42 naira. Ties: 391,854,524 less 298,000,126 equals 93,854,398, and 44,090,298 less 2,582,860 equals 41,507,438. Source: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47705_DANGOTE_SUGAR_REFINERY_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 (nine months ended 30 September 2026) added from Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc consolidated statement of profit or loss page 4, group nine month 2026 column (the page prints qtr3 2026, nine months 2026, qtr3 2025, nine months 2025 and audited twelve months 2025 for both group and company), printed in thousands of naira and stored x1,000. Printed at the group nine month column: revenue 569,409,989; cost of sales -442,938,384; gross profit 126,471,605; other income 23,781,852; selling and distribution 737,729 plus administrative 20,799,325 (operating expenses 21,537,054); operating profit 128,716,403, which is gross profit plus other income less those two expense lines and therefore already includes the other income; finance income 5,212,456 less finance cost 57,520,151 (net finance costs 52,307,695); change in fair value adjustment 1,766,231; profit before tax 78,174,939; taxation 3,927,566; profit after tax 74,247,373. Ties exactly: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit; gross profit plus other income less operating expenses equals the printed operating profit; operating profit less net finance costs plus the fair value adjustment equals profit before tax; profit before tax less taxation equals profit after tax. The printed basic earnings per share row could not be aligned to this column with certainty (its two 2026 values are both 3.67 while the quarter and nine month profits differ by a factor of more than two), so the EPS row is left empty for this period rather than guessed.
